correctness.rationale: Rearrangement identifies every exposed face of a strict permutahedron with an ordered partition whose tangent space consists of independent zero-sum blocks. The weighted KKT equality on a block B gives Jacobian entries delta_ij-a_i/sum_B a with a_i=1/w_i. Direct absolute row summation is 1+(|B|-2)a_i/sum_B a for |B|>=2; singleton rows are zero. Finite polyhedral affine cells cover the projection and all ordered partitions occur, so the global maximum equals the maximum block-row expression and is attained by distinct points in an open cell. Replacing the pivot by the global maximum inverse weight and the remaining coordinates by the smallest ones proves the sorted-prefix formula. Minimax and sharp-supremum conclusions follow by the full-block term and positivity. The standalone exact-rational checker verified 600 exhaustive block comparisons and two 120-vertex weighted-projection optimality witnesses, including finite ratio 303/103. These finite checks are not substituted for the proof.

value.rationale: Anisotropic least-squares ranking projection is a motivated natural object: perturbations can be highly nonuniform although Euclidean contraction remains true in the metric itself. The theorem gives the exact ordinary coordinate-error budget for all strict permutation polytopes, a sorting-time formula, the proper-face-versus-global-affine instability mechanism, and a unique robust-weight optimality classification. These are structural, operationally interpretable facts beyond routine norm equivalence and independent of the generating ranks.
